title: Zesty Mexican Horseradish Tlayudas
description: A fresh and comforting Mexican dish featuring horseradish and bonito shave, served in a Korean brass bowl. This ayurvedic tamasic friendly recipe is perfect for a snack or light meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the corn tortillas into quarters and toast them in the oven for 5 minutes.
Spread a layer of refried beans on each toasted tortilla quarter.
Top the beans with a dollop of horseradish sauce and a sprinkle of bonito flakes.
Sprinkle shredded cheese over the top of each tortilla quarter.
Bake the tlayudas in the oven for an additional 5 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the tlayudas from the oven and top with diced onion and chopped cilantro.
Drizzle lime juice over the top of each tlayuda and serve immediately in a Korean brass bowl.
